title: Great day with Tomas
text: We had a lovely day with Tomas visiting Montserrat. Our planning was short notice and he made it so very easy, we didn't need to worry about any logistics. He took care of everything! He was a great storyteller and wonderful person to share the train ride to and from! He loves history and is well travelled. Great guide!
author: gailhS6079HA

title: Delightful
text: Exploring Montserrat with Tomas was an absolute pleasure. He shared his knowledge of the history and spiritual significance of the monastery with great enthusiasm and appreciation. Tomas made sure that we were able to hear the Boy's Choir as they performed below the holy icon of the Black Madonna. Awesome experience.
author: A3513VVsandrab

title: Montserrat
text: We really enjoyed our day trip with Hannah.  She was a wealth of information and made the visit wonderful.   We especially enjoyed the boys choir and local farmers market.
author: T8936ARmichaelj

title: Elvira was fun and very informative! Our day trip to Montserrat went very smoothly and was stress free.
text: Elvira was fun and very informative! Our day went very smoothly and was stress free. I highly recommend doing this day trip with Elvira. She knows  all the ends and outs for public transportation ( which is a little confusing and very time specific). She is very personable and caters the info provided to your groups interests!

title: Incredible Montserat and Graus winery tour - With Locals - Hosted by Elvira
text:
From the moment we came into contact with Elvira in planning our day trip to Montserat a d the Graus winery she was incredible. The detail and timely communication in planning to just a fantastic day with her. 

She was a joy, so helpful in every regard. It was our first trip to Spain and our first time using With Locals. Highly recommend!! Take the extra time and go on Graus winery tour

Elvira, thank you for leaving us with a life long memory and for being so great.
author: Mobile01079993157

title: Amazing and Fun!
text: Unique place to visit. We were amazed! Our guide Octavio made our day the most fun ever! We made a good friend in Spain. If we come back again Octavio will be our first person we want to spend time with!
author: vkstr27

title: Ilona + WithLocals is a Winning Combination
text: Ilona was our guide for two tremendous station in Barcelona. She has vast knowledge of its history, is  very personable, and will modify the excursions to fit your desires.
author: John J

title: Great day.
text:
The train, the vehicular and the cable car were great experiences. 
Alan our guide went the extra mile. 
It would have been wonderful to be able to walk and appreciate the full Stations of the Cross had time permitted.  A very long walk on the mountain side so peaceful.  
Thanks for a great day Alan.  
Christine and Peter
author: Peter_J

title: Magic in Monserrat
text: Great day trip if you're in Barcelona for more than a few days.  Absolutely breathtaking views from Monserrat.  Make sure your guide takes you on the short hike (moderate  difficulty) to get to the cross where you can see the Pyreenes and the border with France - absolutely gorgeous and serene.  Sebastian was a great guide who knew a lot about the history of the monestary.
